newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu will not name finance chief on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu will not name finance chief on Tuesday.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will not name a new finance chief on Tuesday, his office said.
Analysts had said Netanyahu would appoint hardliner Ariel Sharon on Tuesday but the former general demanded he also get a top security job, complicating the appointment.
"The prime minister is dealing with the matter. No appointments will be made today," said an official in the prime minister's office.
The announcement came as Netanyahu struggled to avoid embarrassment in a parliamentary no-confidence vote expected at 21:30 (1830 GMT).

Sharon, 69, insisted Netanyahu let him join Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai and Foreign Minister David Levy in making up the Israeli leader's team of insiders who hammer out strategy in Arab-Israeli negotiations.

"I stated (to Netanyahu) in a very clear fashion that I have to be on this team...that deals with political security issues," Sharon, of Netanyahu's Likud party, told Israel Radio. The two men failed to resolve the issue at a meeting but agreed to discuss it again on Tuesday or Wednesday.
